status_definitions.completion_rule: A state can advance only with concrete implementation artifacts and a matching native runtime/visual test artifact. Keep native/provider integration boundaries explicit.

architecture.variant_policy: Observed family and state are copied verbatim. variant_id is only a lowercase hyphen normalization of the source state; screenshot ID disambiguates repeated names.
architecture.composition_policy: IDs are proposed reusable contracts, not one class per screen. Listed components form an optional anatomy vocabulary for the recorded state and its family; absence of an optional action in the source must remain absence.
architecture.native_boundary: Native menus, alerts, date controls, permission prompts, payment UI, keyboard, navigation and provider surfaces are hosted, not visually counterfeited. App data, credentials, purchases, account actions and networking remain outside generic layout contracts.
architecture.shell_policy: shell_id is the primary content/presentation composition. shell/adaptive-navigation is a shared host contract available to the architecture, not a second content shell or proof that every source screen contains tabs.
architecture.asset_policy: Use source screenshots only for private reference QA. Ship original/licensed synthetic imagery, app-owned copy, system type and native symbols; no Luma brand or event-poster redistribution is implied.
